mapper.select: SELECT id FROM events WHERE id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.id AS application_id, a.event_id, a.user_id, a.status, e.application_deadline <= now() AS deadline_passed FROM applications a JOIN events e ON e.id = a.event_id WHERE a.event_id = #{eventId} AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status <> 'rejected'
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN my.status = 'waitlisted' THEN ( SELECT count(*)::int FROM applications w WHERE w.event_id = my.event_id AND w.status = 'waitlisted' AND (w.queued_at, w.id) <= (my.queued_at, my.id) ) END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO applications (event_id, user_id, status, applied_at, queued_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{status}, clock_timestamp(), CASE WHEN #{status} = 'pending' THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp() END)
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status <> 'rejected'
mapper.sql: a.user_id, u.nickname, a.status, CASE WHEN a.status = 'waitlisted' THEN (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.status ORDER BY a.queued_at, a.id))::int END AS waitlist_position, a.applied_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM applications a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.event_id = #{eventId} AND a.status <> 'rejected' ORDER BY CASE a.status WHEN 'pending' THEN 0 WHEN 'applied' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, COALESCE(a.queued_at, a.applied_at), a.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.user_id FROM applications a JOIN events e ON e.id = a.event_id WHERE a.event_id = #{eventId} AND a.status = 'pending' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM memberships m WHERE m.community_id = e.community_id AND m.user_id = a.user_id ) ORDER BY a.applied_at, a.id
mapper.update: UPDATE applications SET status = #{status}, queued_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE applications SET status = 'rejected' WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE applications SET status = 'applied' WHERE id IN ( SELECT w.id FROM applications w WHERE w.event_id = #{eventId} AND w.status = 'waitlisted' ORDER BY w.queued_at, w.id LIMIT GREATEST( (SELECT capacity FROM events WHERE id = #{eventId}) - (SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'applied'), 0) ) AND (SELECT application_deadline FROM events WHERE id = #{eventId}) > now()
